# SHA-256 checksums of vendored, self-hosted third-party assets (§A.6 supply-chain integrity).
# The strict CSP forbids any CDN, so d3 is vendored; this file pins its exact bytes. A test
# (tests/test_supply_chain.py) and a CI job fail if the file ever changes without this pin
# being updated deliberately. Regenerate intentionally with:
#   sha256sum netcorenoc/ui/vendor/d3.v7.min.js
